conclusions: A, B and total static Feddes functional error all decrease under the preregistered dyadic refinement sweep.
The all-case numerical-distinguishability frontier for A, B and total error is 0.078125 cm, exactly the 2048-node Reference support.
At 0.15625 cm, total functional error remains above the frozen numerical guard in every tested material/history case.
Therefore the tested mechanism does not support a useful reduced pure-hydraulic vertical support as the complete remedy for the R16 root-feedback error.
This does not by itself select a root-specific state, because D2 diagnoses information demand but not a minimal sufficient root-information representation or its dynamic closure.
